audience: teams that run a Telegram bot for a group, channel or customers

useCases.title: Check a group or channel
useCases.text: Read the chat details, the member count and the administrators.

useCases.title: Look up one chat member
useCases.text: Read the status of a person in a chat.

useCases.title: Read the messages that wait for the bot
useCases.text: Read the pending updates that users sent to the bot. This can remove old updates in Telegram.

useCases.title: Send an announcement
useCases.text: Send a text message from the bot to a chat.

useCases.title: Correct or remove a message
useCases.text: Edit the text of a message that the bot sent, or delete a message.
